question: 每月各商品的销售金额
gold_sql: select substr(o.order_time, 1, 7) as month, p.product_name, sum(oi.subtotal) from orders o join order_items oi on o.order_id = oi.order_id join products p on oi.product_id = p.product_id where o.status = '已完成' group by 1, 2
raw_output:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_time) AS month, p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS sales_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.status = '已完成'
GROUP BY month, p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY month, sales_amount DESC;
